signals.title: Codex persists caller-declared thread-source classification for new and forked executions
signals.title_zh: Codex 为新建与 Fork 执行持久化调用方声明的 Thread Source 分类
signals.summary: Codex exec callers can classify newly created and forked threads with --thread-source; the value is persisted into thread metadata and exposed through the TypeScript SDK, while resume preserves the existing thread source instead of overwriting it.
signals.summary_zh: Codex Exec 调用方现在可通过 --thread-source 为新建与 Fork Thread 分类；该值进入持久 Thread Metadata 并由 TypeScript SDK 暴露，而 Resume 会保留既有 Thread Source，不会覆盖。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK makes output-guardrail blocked placeholders customizable without exposing rejected data
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 在不暴露被拒绝数据的前提下支持自定义 Output Guardrail 阻断占位消息
signals.summary: RunConfig can now supply a synchronous blocked-message string or formatter for terminal output-guardrail rejection. The formatter receives safe metadata rather than rejected output or output_info, and invalid, async or failing formatters fall back to the SDK's data-free default while replay/persistence owners are rebuilt with the sanitized placeholder.
signals.summary_zh: RunConfig 现在可为 Terminal Output Guardrail Reject 配置同步阻断消息或 Formatter。Formatter 只接收安全元数据，不接触被拒绝输出或 output_info；无效、异步或异常 Formatter 会回退到 SDK 的 Data-Free 默认值，同时 Replay / Persistence Owner 使用净化后的占位内容重建。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK strips output-only created_by metadata when replaying RunItems as model input
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 在将 RunItem 重放为模型输入时移除仅属于输出侧的 created_by 元数据
signals.summary: RunItem replay now routes tool calls and outputs through the shared output-to-input conversion path so output-only created_by metadata, including nested shell output metadata, is stripped from replayed model input without mutating the original stored item.
signals.summary_zh: RunItem Replay 现在统一通过 Output-to-Input 转换路径处理 Tool Call 与 Tool Output，从重放给模型的输入中移除仅属于输出侧的 created_by 元数据（包括嵌套 Shell Output），同时不修改原始持久 Item。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK deduplicates repeated MCP server instances before lifecycle ownership
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 在接管 MCP Server 生命周期前去重重复 Server 实例
signals.summary: MCPServerManager now normalizes its owned server list through the existing uniqueness helper, so the same server object supplied repeatedly is connected and cleaned up exactly once rather than receiving duplicate lifecycle operations.
signals.summary_zh: MCPServerManager 现在先通过既有唯一性 Helper 规范化所持有的 Server 列表，因此同一个 Server Object 即使被重复传入，也只会 Connect 与 Cleanup 一次，避免重复生命周期操作。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK advances realtime guardrail state across every threshold crossed by a large transcript delta
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 在大块 Realtime Transcript Delta 跨越多个阈值时同步推进 Guardrail 状态
signals.summary: Realtime output guardrail bookkeeping now advances to the highest debounce threshold already crossed by a large transcript delta, preventing a small following delta from immediately retriggering a guardrail for thresholds that were already passed.
signals.summary_zh: Realtime Output Guardrail 的计数状态现在会直接推进到大块 Transcript Delta 已跨越的最高 Debounce Threshold，避免随后的小 Delta 对已经跨过的阈值再次立即触发 Guardrail。

signals.title: Google ADK preserves HITL function responses when resuming single-turn agent nodes
signals.title_zh: Google ADK 在恢复 Single-Turn Agent Node 时保留 HITL Function Response
signals.summary: When a single-turn workflow node resumes from an HITL tool-confirmation pause with resume_inputs, ADK no longer appends a duplicate synthetic user event that could shadow the operator's FunctionResponse and loop confirmation indefinitely; the original turn input remains in session history.
signals.summary_zh: Single-Turn Workflow Node 从 HITL Tool Confirmation 暂停恢复且带有 resume_inputs 时，ADK 不再追加会遮蔽操作员 FunctionResponse 的重复 Synthetic User Event，从而避免无限确认循环；原始 Turn Input 仍保留在 Session History 中。
